text: 半辈子了，才发现很少为自己活过。
en: Half a lifetime gone, only now do I realise I have rarely lived for myself.

text: 人生后半程，紧迫感像是突然袭来。
en: In the second half of life, a sense of urgency seems to come upon me all at once.

text: 暂时没觉得老了，只是对分水岭不能再视而不见。
en: I don't yet feel old, only that I can no longer turn a blind eye to the watershed.

text: 别人爱怎样怎样，有些人有些事再不值得你付出一丁点时间与精力。
en: Let others do as they please; some people and some things are no longer worth a shred of your time and energy.

text: 慢下来，踏实做事，能弥补多少算多少。
en: Slow down, do things steadily; make up for whatever can be made up.

text: 不强求了。
en: I will no longer force it.

text: 还是要多读一些书，开阔眼界。
en: I should still read more books to broaden my horizons.

text: 以前孩子小，家庭琐事比较多，再加上自己要工作，人到中年，孩子大了，家务活也适当减少了，就要多挤出时间阅读。
en: In the past the children were young and there were many household trivialities, and on top of that I had to work; now that I have reached middle age and the children have grown, the housework has also appropriately lessened, so I must squeeze out more time to read.

text: 读好书，让自己更了解世界，更了解人生。
en: Read good books, to understand the world better and understand life better.

text: 获得更多的精神养料，充实自己，让自己面对生活中的酸甜苦辣更有底气，更从容。
en: Gain more spiritual nourishment, enrich yourself, so that you face the joys and sorrows of life with greater confidence and composure.

text: 找到自己的爱好兴趣，以前匆忙的生活，让自己无暇顾及内在的需求，现在培养和发挥自己的爱好，让自己生活更充实。
en: Find your own hobbies and interests; the hurried life of before left you no time to attend to your inner needs; now cultivate and develop your hobbies, so as to make your life fuller.

text: 丢弃生活中一些不如意，忘掉烦恼，让身心更健康。
en: Discard some of the frustrations in life, forget your troubles, and keep body and mind healthier.

text: 在未来的日子里，将兴趣爱好，成为自己平淡生活中的调味品，有更多的精神追求。
en: In the days to come, let your hobbies and interests become the seasoning of your plain life, with richer spiritual pursuits.

text: 同时能找到一、两项副业，摸索尝试，能赚到钱是更好，给自己或家庭增加经济来源和抗压能力。
en: At the same time, find one or two side businesses, feel your way and try them out; if you can earn money, all the better, adding to your own or your family's income and resilience.

text: 其次，要珍惜自己的家庭，珍惜爱人，因为爱人是自己今后生活相依相伴的战友。
en: Next, cherish your family, cherish your spouse, for your spouse is the comrade who will stand by you through the life ahead.

text: 两个人互相支撑的生活，要比一个人更加的有力量。
en: A life in which two people support each other is stronger than that of one person alone.

text: 互相取长补短，互相照顾，总比一个人面对将来的生活，要更好一些，所以，珍惜身边的人，珍惜家庭里的兄弟姐妹。
en: Making up for each other's shortcomings and looking after one another is always better than facing the future life alone; so cherish those beside you, and cherish the brothers and sisters of your family.

text: 遇事不要太计较，豁达宽容一点，亲情和友情最重要，大事讲原则，小事讲友情。
en: Don't fuss too much over things; be open-minded and tolerant. Kinship and friendship matter most; on major matters uphold principles, on minor matters value friendship.

text: 对周围的人友善，带来大家友好的局面，也让自己心情愉快，也能够让自己的身体更健康。
en: Be kind to those around you; it brings about a friendly atmosphere for everyone, and also makes you happy and keeps your body healthier.

text: 追求健康的生活方式，丢弃和改善过去不健康的生活习惯。
en: Pursue a healthy way of living; discard and improve upon the unhealthy habits of the past.

text: 从现在起，爱惜自己的身体和全家人的健康，适当的给自己安排运动。
en: From now on, take care of your own body and your whole family's health, and arrange appropriate exercise for yourself.

text: 坚持一、两种适合自己的，对自己特别有益的运动方式，让自己不生病，少生病。
en: Persist with one or two forms of exercise that suit you and are especially beneficial, so that you fall ill less and stay well.

text: 计划好生活开支，不浪费钱财，不必需的东西不买，开源节流，精打细算，适当的存钱，以备将来。
en: Plan your living expenses well; do not waste money, do not buy what is not necessary, increase income and reduce expenditure, budget carefully, and save appropriately against the future.

text: 我认为这个问题是分男女的。
en: I think this question differs between men and women.

text: 中年女人和中年男人两极分化，他们的感受体会是截然不同的。
en: Middle-aged women and middle-aged men are polar opposites; their feelings and experiences are utterly different.

text: 不惑之年的男人，风度翩翩、极具魅力，他的人缘非常之好，不管走到哪里，都是人群当中最受人瞩目和欢迎的人物。
en: A man at the age of forty is graceful and full of charm; his popularity is excellent, and wherever he goes he is the most noticed and welcomed figure among the crowd.

text: 正是事业上升期。
en: This is precisely the rising phase of his career.

text: 这个时候的男人当一支花。
en: At this time a man is like a flower at its best.

text: 女人，我是女人，我们重点来说一下女人。
en: Women — I am a woman, so let us focus on women.

text: 不是性别歧视，因为男女心理不一样。
en: This is not sexism, for men's and women's psychology differs.

text: 中年的女人当尴尬疲惫。
en: The middle-aged woman is beset by awkwardness and exhaustion.

text: 上有老人要照顾，下有准备高考要钱的孩子，需要你顾家，体会到生活的不易，事业工作两难。
en: Above are elderly parents to care for, below are children preparing for the gaokao and needing money; you must tend the home, come to know the hardship of life, and find career and work a dilemma.

text: 不敢让自己生病，工作上不顺心也要咬牙支持着。
en: You dare not let yourself fall ill, and must grit your teeth and carry on even when work goes badly.

text: 生活中也已尝遍了酸甜苦辣咸，也不敢轻言放弃，知道了人生没有一帆风顺，也没有捷径可走，平常心态对人对事。
en: In life you have already tasted every flavour — the sweet, sour, bitter, spicy and salty; you dare not speak lightly of giving up, knowing that life is never plain sailing and there is no shortcut, meeting people and things with an ordinary mind.

text: 在这个年纪慢慢看懂了一些人和事，也学会了适时调整心态，靠脚踏实地一步一个脚印走下去。
en: At this age I have slowly come to understand certain people and matters, and have learned to adjust my mindset in good time, pressing on with down-to-earth, step-by-step effort.

text: 容易接受自己的缺点和不足。
en: It becomes easy to accept one's own shortcomings and failings.

text: 学会了欣赏自己的优点，同时也接受了自己的局限性。
en: I have learned to appreciate my strengths, while also accepting my limitations.

text: 这种接受并不意味着我们不努力改进自己，而是意味着我们不再为无法改变的事情而烦恼，矫情。
en: This acceptance does not mean we stop striving to improve ourselves; rather, it means we no longer fret over what cannot be changed, or wallow in self-pity.

text: 40岁后，我们会更加理解爱情需要耐心和时间去培养。
en: After forty, we come to understand better that love needs patience and time to be nurtured.

text: 我们不再追求激情和浪漫，而是更加注重稳定和互相理解的关系。
en: We no longer chase passion and romance, but attend more to stable and mutually understanding relationships.

text: 我们会更加耐心地与伴侣相处，互相支持和包容。
en: We will get along with our partners more patiently, supporting and tolerating one another.

text: 40岁后，我们会更加注重事业的稳定性和持续性。
en: After forty, we pay more attention to the stability and continuity of our careers.

text: 我们怕没工作怕失业怕没钱怕病重怕失去亲人。
en: We fear having no work, fear unemployment, fear having no money, fear grave illness, fear losing loved ones.

text: 40岁后，我们会更加注重健康和保养及养生。
en: After forty, we pay more attention to health, upkeep and nourishing the body.

text: 我们开始意识到健康是幸福的基础，而没有健康就没有一切。
en: We begin to realise that health is the foundation of happiness, and without health there is nothing.

text: 我们会更加注重饮食、运动和休息，保持良好的生活习惯。
en: We pay more attention to diet, exercise and rest, keeping up good living habits.

text: 40岁了，我们会更容易放下过去的痛苦和遗憾。
en: At forty, we find it easier to let go of past pain and regret.

text: 我们开始意识到这些经历让我们变得更加坚强和成熟，而不是阻碍我们的发展。
en: We begin to realise these experiences have made us stronger and more mature, rather than holding back our development.

text: 我们会更加积极面对未来，不再被过去的阴影所束缚。
en: We will face the future more positively, no longer bound by the shadows of the past.

text: 这些是我在40岁以后明白的事情。
en: These are the things I came to understand after turning forty.

text: 每个人的经历和领悟都不同，所以这些可能并不完全适用于您的情况。
en: Everyone's experiences and insights differ, so these may not apply entirely to your situation.

text: 无论如何，我希望您能够珍惜这个年龄段所带来的智慧和经验，更好地面对未来的人生挑战。
en: In any case, I hope you can cherish the wisdom and experience this age brings, and face the challenges of life ahead better.

text: 早晨
en: Morning

text: 心里有事，一晚上都迷迷糊糊，似睡似醒。
en: With something on my mind, I drifted in a haze all night, half asleep, half awake.

text: 感觉窗帘被朝阳透进一些光，睁开眼睛看看挂钟，依稀只有5点半。
en: I felt the curtains let in a little light from the morning sun; I opened my eyes and looked at the wall clock — it was barely half past five.

text: 甫清醒，烦闹立刻充满心头，遗憾不能够一直睡下去。
en: No sooner awake than irritation flooded my heart; I regretted not being able to go on sleeping.

text: 看看身旁熟睡的妻，愧疚。
en: I looked at my wife sleeping beside me, and felt guilty.

text: 挨到6点半，起床，第一次叫儿子起床。
en: I waited until half past six, got up, and woke my son for the first time.

text: 洗漱。
en: Washed and freshened up.

text: 准备儿子的早饭: 全家的饭团和牛奶。
en: Prepared my son's breakfast: rice balls and milk for the whole family.

text: 第二次叫儿子起床。
en: Woke my son for the second time.

text: 儿子起床，祝我生日快乐。
en: My son got up and wished me a happy birthday.

text: 这是妻定的规矩，家庭成员应在当天第一时刻祝福寿星。
en: This is a rule my wife set: family members should offer their birthday wishes to the celebrant at the very first moment of the day.

text: 开车送儿子赶7点10分的校车。
en: Drove my son to catch the school bus at ten past seven.

text: 时间还早，往常不想折腾，直接去公司。
en: It was still early; usually I would not bother and would go straight to the office.

text: 今天，回家。
en: Today, I went home.

text: 老婆已起床，祝我生日快乐。
en: My wife had got up and wished me a happy birthday.

text: 蒸几个烧麦当早饭。
en: Steamed a few shaomai for breakfast.

text: 老婆提醒我不要忘记向老板争取正当利益。
en: My wife reminded me not to forget to stand up to my boss for my proper interests.

text: 上午，离职
en: Morning — leaving the company

text: 大约9点半，HR来我办公室交代离职流程，各部门人员来给我签字，10点半前都好了，只剩董事长的签字需要我自己去找他。
en: At about half past nine, HR came to my office to explain the resignation procedure; people from each department came to have me sign, and by half past ten it was all done, except the chairman's signature, which I had to go and get myself.

text: 董事长不到60岁，前年因各种因缘，从外地到我所在城市设立新集团，进入几个新业务领域。
en: The chairman is under sixty; the year before last, for various reasons, he came from another city to the city where I am based and set up a new group, entering several new business areas.

text: 我恰在某相关领域的外资公司十数年，但正处于低谷，猎头寻来。
en: I happened to have spent a dozen or so years at a foreign-funded company in a related field, but was at a low ebb when a headhunter found me.

text: 我做调查，看到老板有特殊背景，并非寻常民营老板，以为是极佳机遇，于是加入，负责某业务公司。
en: I did my research, saw that the boss had a special background and was no ordinary private-sector boss, thought it an excellent opportunity, and so joined, taking charge of a certain business company.

text: 经过一年，实在不能适应企业文化(大量政府和国企背景的同僚，你也许知道会是什么情况)，业务也难于打开局面，董事长用人素有蜜月期和一年一换之说，开始使用排挤手段。
en: After a year, I simply could not adapt to the corporate culture (a great many colleagues with government and state-owned-enterprise backgrounds — you may know what that means), and the business was hard to get off the ground. The chairman is known for a 'honeymoon period' and a 'change every year' approach to staff, and began to use exclusionary tactics.

text: 其实他大可不必，我在人事方面素无斗志，于是上周主动提出辞职。
en: In fact he need not have bothered; I have never had the fighting spirit for office politics, so last week I took the initiative and handed in my resignation.

text: 今天，是最后一天。
en: Today is the last day.

text: 找他签字，尚有一事。
en: When I went to get his signature, there was still one matter.

text: 入职时老板交代HR，我的薪资水平超公司预算太多，但公司诚心用我，所以商量可否将薪资20%作为奖金包在每满一年时发放。
en: When I joined, the boss told HR that my salary level exceeded the company budget by too much, but the company sincerely wanted me, so we discussed whether 20% of my salary could be made into a bonus pool, paid out each time a full year was completed.

text: 我虽然对这种操作不以为然，但急于切换环境，也就答应了。
en: Although I disapproved of this arrangement, I was eager to change environments and so agreed.

text: 现在，找他了结此事。
en: Now, I went to him to settle the matter.

text: 结果呢，可笑可悲。
en: The result? Ridiculous and lamentable.

text: 可笑的是，素来强势的老板，为了少付几万元的工资，说软话，只愿意付一半。
en: What is ridiculous is that the usually domineering boss, to pay a few tens of thousands of yuan less in wages, spoke soft words and would only pay half.

text: 可悲的是，我不想再纠缠，答应了。
en: What is lamentable is that I, not wishing to wrangle further, agreed.

text: 中午，有其他公司同僚请吃饭，谢绝了。
en: At noon a colleague from another company invited me to a meal, which I declined.

text: 现在，我是个失败者，只想尽快离开。
en: Now, I am a failure, and only wish to leave as soon as possible.

text: 下午，天涯沦落人
en: Afternoon — fellow exiles

text: 这个酸溜溜的感觉算是无病呻吟吗？
en: Does this sour, self-pitying feeling count as making a fuss over nothing?

text: 我和一个大学同学约了2点钟喝咖啡聊天。
en: I arranged with a university classmate to meet at two o'clock for coffee and a chat.

text: 中午没滋没味的吃了一碗面。
en: At noon I ate a bowl of noodles without any appetite.

text: 然后到旁边的公园茫无目的地转圈。
en: Then I went to the nearby park and wandered in circles with no purpose.

text: 中午时分，虽是晴天，但我觉得灰蒙蒙的。
en: At midday, though it was a clear day, everything seemed grey to me.

text: 人来人往，大家看上去都春风得意，我不知为何别人有这许多愉快。
en: People came and went; everyone looked pleased with themselves, and I could not fathom why others had so much happiness.

text: 同学几年前厌烦了合伙创业，索性全职炒股。
en: A few years back my classmate grew tired of joint entrepreneurship and simply became a full-time stock trader.

text: 几年前抓住了行情，在军工板块赚了几百万。
en: A few years ago he caught the market trend and made several million in the military-industry sector.

text: 快一年不见，今天互相聊聊近况。
en: We had not met for nearly a year; today we caught up on recent happenings.

text: 同学说，他过去两年也不顺，曾经的斩获都快还给市场了。
en: My classmate said his last two years had not gone well either; his past gains had nearly all been given back to the market.

text: 他是个乐观之人，自言此乃天道，平常除了看财报，就以游山玩水为主。
en: He is an optimist, saying this is the way of heaven; usually, apart from reading financial reports, he mainly travels and enjoys the scenery.

text: 但他头发白的真厉害。
en: But his hair has turned remarkably white.

text: 说起各自周边，无甚喜闻乐见之事。
en: Speaking of what goes on around each of us, there was nothing cheerful to report.

text: 而我，今天开始就是个中年失业人了。
en: As for me, from today I am a middle-aged unemployed man.

text: 其实，过去一年我早知不妙，上下求索寻求新职，猎头来者不拒，怎奈无合适机会。
en: In truth, I had known for a year that things were amiss; I searched high and low for a new post and accepted every headhunter's approach, yet no suitable opportunity came.

text: 究其原因，一者年纪偏大，二者过去几年职业经历动荡，均为现今用人者大忌。
en: The reasons: first, my age is on the high side; second, my professional experience in recent years has been unstable — both being great taboos for today's employers.

text: 不知这次失业不知要持续多久。
en: I do not know how long this spell of unemployment will last.

text: 生日快乐！
en: Happy birthday!

text: 5点钟就进我家小区了。
en: I was back in my residential estate by five o'clock.

text: 我没有在这个小区买车位，往常下班回来停车极费力。
en: I did not buy a parking space in this estate; usually, coming home from work, parking was a great struggle.

text: 今天，空余的共享车位还很多，我挑了个方便进出的，不禁自嘲这也算是无业之便利。
en: Today there were still many vacant shared parking spaces; I picked one convenient for coming and going, and could not help mocking myself — this too counts as a convenience of being jobless.

text: 工作日，晚饭未做特别安排。
en: On a workday, no special arrangement was made for dinner.

text: 只是在餐后多了一个蛋糕。
en: Only, after the meal, there was an extra cake.

text: 点起生日蜡烛，妻和儿子笑语祝福。
en: We lit the birthday candles, and my wife and son offered their blessings with smiles and laughter.

text: 我，亦合掌祈祷。
en: I too pressed my palms together and prayed.

text: 明天，是新的一天。
en: Tomorrow is a new day.
